title: A Contact for the Asset
author: Ansel Vane
blurb: Noor Dunmore, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
